forms.alt: 湏,⿰⿱分巾頁*,⿰⿱分立頁*,⿰⿱分豆頁*

glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): 彡 (“hair”) + 頁 (“head”) – a head with hair on its side – beard; whiskers — original character of 鬚. Originally a single picture, but abstracted in the seal script into a compound.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 須 (頁 → 页). / Simplified from 鬚 (髟 → and 頁 → 页).
senses: [xū] (alt. form 䇓, 𩓣) (obsolete in standard Chinese) to wait
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 須; s_page_origin explains the simplified 须.
